insights.summary: PreSense data does not carry over when Genesys transfers a call from sales to retention.
insights.quote: Every time we transfer from sales to retention in Genesys, the PreSense data just doesn't come across. The second agent gets nothing.

insights.summary: AI Voice Agent handoff to a live rep loses the account number, so customers repeat it.
insights.quote: The voice agent is handing people to a live rep and the rep has to ask for the account number again. That's the one thing we told customers they wouldn't have to do.

insights.summary: Procurement questions AI Voice Agent per-minute pricing on top of the platform fee.
insights.quote: Procurement is going to ask me why AI Voice Agent is priced per minute on top of the platform fee. I need a better answer than I have.

insights.summary: The attribution-by-campaign view is the first report the digital team opens each morning.
insights.quote: The new attribution view by campaign is honestly the report my team opens first every morning.
